bars: Tests on the web, all of them: 61 of 62 suites pass. The one left, the phone checks of the page, fails 2 checks in 3 of 3 runs, and fails the same way on the code from before the four changes: not caused by them, not timing
Before my fixes: the scoped run stopped at 1 failure (a test that assumed it is not root); the full run had 2 more counts to update for the 3 new web hooks

Bugs found in the four commits: 3 real (a product name like Node.js refused as a file name; two pieces could get the same number; the sub help line still showed the old form), 0 blocking, all 3 fixed with a test
Live line on the web: 1 of 1 real run: this step's own hook wrote its line, the push carried it to the Artifact (written there at version 1)
Cost in characters, measured here: resume for a part 15425, form 150, done 683 (unfilled form), sub 73, permission-mode 4, commands 226 (a topic: 235)
A web part launched in the orchestrator's own words is now recognized as a part: 1 of 1 (this session; before: 0, no live line and no pieces from its task list)
body: Four kit changes, made and tested on a computer, are on branch feat/streamline-doctor-memory (95f0eab..309ba6c): a step's numbered pieces, a plain-words check on what he reads first, a live line saying what a running step is doing, a loop breaker, and every check off by default once he accepts it. Review them, run them for real on the web, and say what each costs.
check: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_cl31_card_push.py tests/test_post_gate.py tests/test_unified_hooks.py -k "live_line or cl41 or every_check or only_a_part or table_is"
handoff: Rebuild and republish the Artifact board page from this branch (update_board.py, then publish to the same url) so the live line shows there. The page reads the step's line on the board that holds the step. Web parts launched in free words must keep the words "You are part" and "--role part --post <id>" for their hook to find their post.
not_checked: The board page itself is not republished: the line shows in the Artifact only after the page is rebuilt from this version (the page test proves it reads the right place).
The loop breaker and the live line were not run on a computer here (no computer attached); their tests ran.
Why the page's phone checks fail on the web (folding a train at 411 px): same failure before the four changes; left for its own step.

task:
Get the code: clone anlonlt/board, `git checkout feat/streamline-doctor-memory` (the four commits are 95f0eab..309ba6c), then `python3 -I install.py . --update --no-cmd`.

What changed (each with its tests): `done` refuses open pieces and code in the verdict or lead; `kit_activity.py` writes activity/<post> (what it does now, no model call, at most every 15 s; a loop of 8 identical calls is said once); `kit.py permission-mode` (bypass once the owner accepted it, else auto); hooks find the project above a subfolder; page tests close their browser.

1. Review the four commits for real bugs: say each with file:line, or none.
2. Run the scoped tests (`python3 scripts/run_all_tests.py`), then `--all` once: numbers, and any failure that is not timing.
3. Run the new commands for real here and measure each in characters: `resume --role part`, `form`, `done`, `sub`, `permission-mode`, `commands`.
4. Make the live line work for a web part: its hook cannot reach a local board; find the way (ArtifactData through the push, or the board's own page), build it, test it.
5. Report what a web session sees of `permission-mode` (web ignores bypass) and whether anything here needs a change for the web.
title: Review and adopt four kit changes made on a computer (patch in this post)
verdict: Adopted: no blocking bug, three small ones fixed, 61 of 62 suites green on the web (the last fails the same before the changes), and a web step's live line now reaches the Artifact board.
